title: Structured Role-Aware Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2605.07274v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), especially with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has shown strong potential for improving the reasoning capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs). However, in multimodal reasoning, final-answer rewards are typically assigned at the sequence level and do not distinguish the functional roles of different tokens, making it difficult to determine whether a correct answer is supported by task-relevant visual evidence. translated_title: 面向多模态推理的结构化角色感知策略优化
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），尤其是结合组相对策略优化（GRPO），在提升大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的推理能力方面已展现出强大潜力。然而，在多模态推理中，最终答案奖励通常是在序列级别进行分配的，无法区分不同token的功能角色，因此难以判断一个正确答案是否得到了与任务相关的视觉证据的支持。在本文中，我们从角色感知的token级信用分配视角重新审视多模态RLVR，将结构化响应分解为用于提取视觉证据的感知token，以及用于从这些证据推导出答案的推理token。基于这一视角，我们提出了结构化角色感知策略优化（SRPO），该方法在不改变……（原文在此处截断）的前提下，将序列级的GRPO优势细化为角色感知的token级优势。
tldr: 该论文提出结构化角色感知策略优化（SRPO），通过将多模态结构化响应分解为感知token与推理token，把序列级的GRPO优势细化为角色感知的token级优势，实现更精确的信用分配，从而确保正确答案有任务相关的视觉证据支撑。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Structured Role-aware Policy Optimization (SRPO), which decomposes structured multimodal responses into perception tokens and reasoning tokens, and refines sequence-level GRPO advantages into role-aware token-level advantages for more precise credit assignment in multimodal RLVR.
